hypotheses.justification: Let t := toMeasurable volume s. Volume on finite-dimensional U is σ-finite, so Measure.restrict_toMeasurable_of_sfinite gives volume.restrict t = volume.restrict s. Thus hint also gives integrability on t. Apply ae_summable_fiber to the measurable set t with constant weight 1, and use the original summability argument to obtain almost-everywhere finite fibers over t. Since s ⊆ t by subset_toMeasurable, Set.Finite.subset gives finite fibers over s. This also covers empty sets, zero-dimensional spaces, and vanishing Jacobians; no positivity assumption is needed.
